exposure: Pain intensity during movement at 24 and 48 hours
Pain intensity at rest at 24 and 48 hours
outcome: Adverse effects (pruritus, nausea, sedation, respiratory depression, hypotension, urinary retention and paresthesias)
cohort: 204 women who underwent cesarean section after previous epidural catheter placement
finding: There were no differences in pain scores between the three epidural analgesic regimens, but the morphine bolus group had a lower incidence of adverse events.
